connector.name: Easyeda MCP Pro
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for EasyEDA Pro: PCB inspection, BOM, exports, and hardware review.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package easyeda-mcp-pro. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oaslananka account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: TOOL_PROFILE
env.description: Active tool profile (core, pro, full, dev, experimental)

env.name: MCP_BRIDGE_BACKEND
env.description: Bridge backend: local_bridge or experimental remote_relay

env.name: MCP_REMOTE_SESSION_ID
env.description: Optional fixed Remote Relay session id for the remote_relay backend

env.name: HTTP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX
env.description: Max requests per minute per IP

env.name: CORS_ORIGIN
env.description: Allowed CORS origin for HTTP transport

env.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for HTTP transport (use * for wildcard)

env.name: MCP_TASKS_ENABLED
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: parsed for compatibility, but the server does not advertise or execute MCP Tasks.

env.name: MCP_APPS_ENABLED
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: parsed for compatibility, but no MCP Apps UI or resource runtime is registered.

env.name: MCP_V2_EXPERIMENTAL
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: does not change MCP protocol negotiation.

env.name: MCP_RAW_EXEC_EXPERIMENTAL
env.description: Enable experimental raw EasyEDA runtime execution gate (dangerous; requires BRIDGE_RAW_EXEC_ENABLED)

env.name: BRIDGE_HOST
env.description: Bridge WebSocket host for EasyEDA Pro connection

env.name: BRIDGE_PORT_SCAN
env.description: Port scan specification (comma-separated ports or ranges)

env.name: BRIDGE_WAIT_FOR_EDA_MS
env.description: How long to wait for EasyEDA Pro to become available on startup (ms)

env.name: BRIDGE_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE
env.description: Max bridge payload size in bytes

env.name: BRIDGE_RAW_EXEC_ENABLED
env.description: Enable raw method execution on bridge (dangerous)

env.name: AI_PROVIDER
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: no in-process AI provider client is invoked.

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: retained for future provider integration only.

env.name: AI_API_KEY
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: do not supply credentials because no provider client consumes them.

env.name: AI_ALLOW_DESIGN_MUTATIONS
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: cannot enable AI-originated design mutation.

env.name: OAUTH_JWKS_URI
env.description: JWKS endpoint for token signature validation

env.name: OTEL_ENABLED
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: no OTLP exporter is started.

env.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
env.description: Reserved; currently non-functional: retained for a future OTLP exporter.
